_comment: ALL EIGHT topological_offset cases are commented out -- the file names are parked in _commented_out below, and their configs are still in this directory. Nothing here runs. The 2D three (topological_offset_2d, _2d_vertex_input, _2d_dragon) came out first, while 2D was reworked to match 3D. The 3D three came out with them: the 2D and 3D optimizations now share one flow, and neither converges on the ESP-based offset potential, so registering them would only assert a known failure. Their configs also still carry keys the current topological_offset spec has deleted, and the spec is strict, so they would fail to parse. THE LAST TWO ARE DIFFERENT IN KIND: their configs DO parse against the current spec, and they are parked because the case FAILS, not because it cannot be read. Both are fixtures for the SAME open problem -- two offset fronts approaching one curve, where the summed potential never falls to the level c so those vertices chase a level set that does not exist, and the stuck-refine calls they generate run the ambient mesh away to 1e50. topological_offset_2d_two_circles is the outward form: two unit circles whose centres are exactly 2 + 2*target_distance apart, so at target_distance 0.1 the two offsets are EXACTLY TANGENT at the origin and the offset is a pinched figure-eight. topological_offset_2d_annots_tag4_in is the INWARD form and is much cheaper to reproduce: offsetting tag_4 inward by 0.1 collides the front with itself on the region's medial axis wherever tag_4 is thinner than 2*target_distance, which for an inward offset is the default rather than the exception. Measured 2026-08-23: aborts in round 10 phase A with max element quality 1e+50, the degenerate cluster at 0.15x target_distance from the input complex with Phi/c = 2.28 and the sizing field already at its floor. They are here because that is the case the 2D work is stuck on, and a fixture nobody can load is a fixture nobody can reproduce. Re-add a name to integration_tests once its config parses against the spec and the case is expected to pass; the group is hidden ([.]) either way, so run it explicitly with ./wmtk_integration_tests "[offset]".
